Name: string
Description: Arbitrary text scalar; supports enum restriction and default value

Name: integer
Description: Exact integer scalar; coerced for numeric facet comparisons

Name: number
Description: Floating-point numeric scalar; rejects NaN and Inf

Name: date
Description: Calendar date; RFC 3339 timestamps index their YYYY-MM-DD date as the facet

Name: enum
Description: Restricts scalar or list items to a closed set of allowed values

Name: list
Description: Sequence of items (a single scalar in YAML is promoted to a 1-item list)

Name: ref
Allowed_Values_or_Syntax: Document stem or workspace-relative path or $KB_ROOT/...
Description: Typed document reference; resolved into the workspace knowledge graph

Name: required
Description: Reports a diagnostic when the field is absent or empty in frontmatter

Name: values / enum
Allowed_Values_or_Syntax: List of unique valid strings or scalars
Description: Narrows allowed values; v2 types may narrow a base enum subset

Name: default
Allowed_Values_or_Syntax: Scalar or list matching the field type
Description: Facet value answered when a document omits the optional field

Name: managed
Description: Reserved for daemon-owned lifecycle fields; rejects client edits

Name: strict
Description: Flags any frontmatter key not declared in common/base or the active type

Name: yaml
Description: Unclosed fence or syntax error inside the leading --- block

Name: unknown_type
Description: Document's discriminator value is not declared under types.<name>

Name: required
Description: Declared required field is missing or null

Name: type
Description: Value cannot be parsed as the declared field type

Name: enum
Description: Value is not a member of the field's declared enum set

Name: unknown_field
Description: Frontmatter contains a key not declared for this document type
